blocks.text: A Calibration Engineer is responsible for ensuring that measuring and test instruments provide accurate, traceable and reliable measurements. The role combines instrumentation, sensors, measurement systems, electronics, industrial automation, quality systems and technical documentation. Typical environments include process industries, manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, laboratories, energy, aerospace, automotive and electronics.
